description: Switch between multiple Claude Code accounts in two clicks from the status bar.
command.switch.title: Switch Account
command.add.title: Add Account
command.saveCurrent.title: Save Current Account
command.delete.title: Delete Profile
config.reloadAfterSwitch.description: Reload the window after switching account. Not needed with current versions of Claude Code, which pick up the new account by themselves.
config.claudePath.description: Path of the claude CLI used by "Add Account". Empty = the binary shipped with the Claude Code extension, otherwise `claude` from the PATH.
command.switchPrevious.title: Switch to Previous Account
command.rename.title: Rename Profile
config.showUsageInStatusBar.description: Show the usage of the active account (highest of the 5-hour and weekly limits) in the status bar.
config.usageRefreshMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) to refresh the active account's usage from Anthropic, while VS Code is focused. 0 = never call the service, only read the usage cached by Claude Code.
config.usageAlertThreshold.description: Warn when the active account reaches this percentage of its 5-hour or weekly limit, and offer to switch to the least used account. 0 = no warning.
